title: nan
authors: Russell J.S.; Ye M.; Anderson B.D.O.; Hmam H.; Sarunic P.
key_contribution: Presents a cooperative 3D localization method for a GPS-denied UAV utilizing Direction of Arrival (DOA) measurements from an assisting GPS-equipped UAV.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Hybrid_Classical_Learning to ensure precise positioning.
